description.raw: '''Innate:''' Periodically, '''Ziggs''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] to deal 20 – 184 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 50% AP) '''bonus''' magic damage,「 increased by 75% against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. 」「 increased to 35 – 322 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 87.5% AP) against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. 」
description.text: Innate: Periodically, Ziggs empowers his next basic attack to deal 20 – 184 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 50% AP) bonus magic damage,「 increased by 75% against structures. 」「 increased to 35 – 322 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 87.5% AP) against structures. 」

description2.raw: ''Short Fuse's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reduced by 4 / 5 / 6 (based on level) seconds whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|ability]].
description2.text: Short Fuse's  cooldown is reduced by 4 / 5 / 6 (based on level) seconds whenever Ziggs casts an ability.

notes.raw: * The empowered attack will not trigger against [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]]. * The cooldown reduction is granted at the start of the abilities' cast time. * ''Short Fuse'' will go on cooldown but not deal any damage if the attack misses due to [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blind]]. * PENDING FOR TEST:: ''Short Fuse's'' interactions with [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodging]] and [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocking]] effects.
notes.text:
The empowered attack will not trigger against wards.
The cooldown reduction is granted at the start of the abilities' cast time.
Short Fuse will go on cooldown but not deal any damage if the attack misses due to blind.
PENDING FOR TEST:: Short Fuse's interactions with dodging and blocking effects.
